primary_goal: Identify the strongest YouTube channels for learning practical speaking, communication, humor, storytelling, and delivery.

channels.name: Ultraspeaking
channels.why_selected: Strong fit for fear reduction, practical drills, and learning to speak more fluidly without over-reliance on scripting.

channels.name: Vinh Giang
channels.why_selected: High-value channel for making delivery, energy, and audience engagement practical and teachable.

channels.name: Think Fast Talk Smart
channels.why_selected: Strong source for frameworks that help people think clearly and speak clearly in real professional situations.

channels.name: Charisma on Command
channels.why_selected: Useful for studying social presence, audience connection, and communication patterns through examples from public figures.

channels.name: Toastmasters International
channels.why_selected: Valuable because it offers real speech examples, not only advice.

channels.name: TED
channels.why_selected: Strong example library for polished speaking and memorable talk architecture.

channels.name: TEDx Talks
channels.why_selected: Broader and noisier than TED, but extremely useful as a large example corpus for comparing stronger and weaker talks.

channels.name: Communication Coach Alexander Lyon
channels.why_selected: Useful for practical workplace communication and professional speaking.

channels.name: The Communication Coach
channels.why_selected: Worth tracking as a secondary source for broader communication material.

channels.name: Speak The Speech
channels.why_selected: Useful secondary source for pressure situations and delivery.
